mapper.insert: insert ignore into mall_favorite (user_id, product_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from mall_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from mall_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
select count(*) from mall_favorite where user_id = #{userId}

select p.id, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.brand_id, b.name as brand_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.price_low, p.price_high, p.stock, p.sales, p.rating, p.status, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time from mall_favorite f join mall_product p on p.id = f.product_id left join mall_category c on c.id = p.category_id left join mall_brand b on b.id = p.brand_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc, f.id desc
